title: WTC Data Center and Clinical Center of Excellence
agency_path: City of New York > Fire Department
description_text: The Fire Department responded to a Request for Proposal from the United States Department of Health and Human Services, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH) and was awarded contract for the continued provision of WTC Related Health Care Services. In the approved proposals submitted to the CDC/NIOSH, Research Triangle Institute (RTI) has been identified as a subcontractor to provide Data Center and Clinical Center of Excellence services in support of FDNY's performance of the contract requirements. The proposals are in cooperated into the CDC's contract.
